## Summary

Describe the user-visible problem and result.

## Authority and security impact

Explain effects on agent permissions, human approvals, evidence, persistence,
audit integrity, or external boundaries. Write "none" only after checking.

## Validation

- [ ] Standard-library tests pass.
- [ ] Branch coverage was reviewed.
- [ ] Repository scans pass.
- [ ] Reachable Git history scan passes.
- [ ] Synthetic demo passes.
- [ ] Temporary package build and inspection pass.
- [ ] New behavior has denial and malformed-input tests.
- [ ] Workflow actions are pinned to full commit identifiers when applicable.

## Provenance and data

- [ ] The contribution is original or has a documented compatible source.
- [ ] No confidential, personal, customer-specific, or production material is included.
- [ ] Examples and fixtures are synthetic.
- [ ] License and third-party notices are updated if needed.

## Documentation

- [ ] User and operator documentation matches the implementation.
- [ ] Changelog and readiness ledger are updated when applicable.
- [ ] Claims remain evidence-based.
